intro: In this Reiki course, we have combined our level 1 and level 2 Reiki healing courses to give you knowledge and skills starting from building the strong foundation, and to the advanced level with some extra techniques. You will master the theoretical and practical aspects of Reiki healing, as well as how to create an optimal healing environment as a Reiki healer.

Whether your aim is to heal yourself and your loved ones or to establish a career as a professional Reiki healer, this Level 1 & 2 Reiki Healing Course in Bali will give you the basic and essential knowledge and skills to succeed. Our dedicated team of experienced Reiki teachers is here to share their expertise and guide you on this transformative journey.

At Bali Yoga School, we create an atmosphere of authenticity and mutual support among staff and teachers, creating an ideal learning environment for spiritual seekers from around the world. With two swimming pools nestled within our tranquil gardens and a spacious, serene campus, you’ll find the perfect setting to deepen your healing practice and explore holistic well-being.

policies.title: Important Things to Know before Signing Up
items: Becoming a reiki healer completely depends on an individual’s austerity which can take years.
Reiki is not against medical science. It works together to bring a speedy recovery.
During the reiki practices, one should not indulge in sexual activities.
A true healer is never against medical science, but he/she always works together with it.

If any healer tries to make you believe that reiki healing is above medical science, do not believe the person because both practices work together just as your body needs both legs to make a balance.
Reiki and yoga work well together to achieve great health.
A true reiki healer’s energy speaks (honesty, compassion, respect, love).
Our course certificate confirms you have practiced the reiki under the supervision of an experienced teacher.

We suggest all the practitioners to pursue simple and nutritious diet / early sleep and early wake up / physical exercises / not to eat any kind of meat / take drugs or alcohol. Following the guidelines will help you to experience the depth of reiki practices.

policies.title: Management Authority
items: The management team is authorised to make the necessary changes in the daily schedule if needed. These adjustments ensure smooth coordination of classes and the best experience for all participants.

policies.title: Course Booking & Confirmation
items: To book for the course, please deposit the complete course fees of 100 USD. An official confirmation letter for your program will be sent shortly after successful payment of the yoga retreat fees.

policies.title: Asanas Class
items: The purpose of the asana classes is to support your body and mind in the healing process during your healing course journey. These sessions promote personal well-being rather than provide professional-level training in asanas or alignment techniques.

policies.title: 1 Hour Self Practice
items: You can engage in a one-hour self-practice session in the HYA Healing Studio using available instruments. Any damage to equipment during practice must be covered by you.

policies.title: Important Note
items: The school reserves the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.
